newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices firm on mill buying.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices firm on mill buying.

text.p: Indian cotton prices firmed at improved levels on Friday on fresh mill buying and purchasing by state agencies, dealers said.
They said new crop arrivals at producing centre also fell due to severe cold weather.
In spot deals Bengal-deshi was steady at 840/875 rupees per maund (37.32 kg), Punjab saw-ginned at 1,450/1,550 rupees for the medium variety and at 1,625/1,650 rupees for the superior variety.
Gujarat Sankar-4 (long-staple) eased by 100 rupees to 18,000/18,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
